title: Law to let sidewalk cafes pay fees quarterly
summary: This bill would let sidewalk and roadway cafe operators pay their annual revocable consent fees to the city in quarterly installments instead of one lump sum. It would take effect 120 days after becoming law. Fees range from $6 to $31 per square foot for sidewalk cafes and $5 to $25 per square foot for roadway cafes depending on the zone.
